title: Secrets of Pope Benedict’s Visit
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.) Dastoor.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultan Allah.
Allahuma salli wa sallim wa baarik `alaa Habeebika Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l-Akhireen (s), Hadrat
Rasoolullah, Sayyidina Muhammad wa `ala aalihi wa saahbihi ajma`een. Ameen.
Allah Allah. SubhaanAllah. Say, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'rRaheem! (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) Yaa Rabbee, bismik al-Jaleel min al-azali ‘l-abadi. (Mawlana Shaykh
sits.) O our Lord! You are granting such endless honor, for us to be able to say, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'rRaheem! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits.)
Huuuuuu. As-salaamu `alaykum, first to `ibaadullahi ‘s-Saliheen, on whom every second heavenly Mercy
Oceans rain, and they are asking, "O our Lord! Grant us more and more!" They are holy ones. For the honor
of holy ones, the Lord of Creation is protecting this planet, and it is under the holy control of Qutb alMutasarrif, who has such authority, power, and honor to keep this planet. If he is not keeping, in less than a

second this world may run away from its orbit and no one knows to where, it will just disappear! One only, is
able to control one, ten, one-hundred, one-thousand, ten-thousand, one-hundred-thousand nafs al-waqt, at
the same time!
O Salafi `ulama! You are claiming you know everything and you know nothing! What is the Lord of Heavens
saying? (Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
••••• ••••••••• •••••• ••••• ••••••••
Wa maa qadroollaha haqqa qadrih, No just estimate of Allah do they make. (al-Anaam, 6:91)
What I am saying is nothing!
•••••••• •••••••• ••••• ••••••• ••••••• •••• ••••••• •••• •••• •••••••••
Innama amruhu itha arada shay’an an yaqoola lahu kun fayakoon, Verily, when He intends a thing, His
Command is, ‘be,’ and it is! (YaSeen 36:82)
(Mawlana Shaykh sits.) If He is ordering one holy one to look after the whole universe whose ends you try to
reach, that one is able to!
•••••••• •••••••••• •••••••• Wa khuliqa ’l-insaanu da`eefa, “Man is created weak,” (an-Nisaa, 4:28)
but an order is making that one powerful and a heavenly command is authorizing that one, “Look at
everything in this universe," and he can look. Wa maa qadroollaha haqqa qadrih.
Why are you not saying this? Why are you not giving more and more knowledge about our Creator? That is
what they are granting to a weakest servant to speak, but there are gigantic ones that no one other than them
can reach those horizons! For every holy one there is going to be a horizon and his horizon may go on, but it
can't be finished, because everything that belongs to the Lord of Heavens is endless, Eternal!
We are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem, because Shaytan is quickly coming to make our
understanding on a wrong direction. The true direction is only one and wrong directions are countless.
Therefore, one day the Seal of Prophets (s) was sitting with his ashaab, Companions (r), making a line with a
stick, and he said, "That is the Straight Way, it is one.” Then on the right and left he made lines like this and

that, saying, "What I am showing are wrong ways, and wrong ways on the Straight Way are countless. The
straight direction is only one, from Allah to Allah, from pre-Eternal up to Eternal. Wrong ways are what
Shaytan makes people follow.”
Therefore, you can find the desires of our egos to be countless. If there are a billion, trillion, or quadrillion
men, there are a quadrillion different desires. SubhaanAllah. And who is making those quadrillion desires
on wrong directions is Shaytan; it makes our ego think a different wish so that we live:
••••• •••••• ••••• ••••••• ••••••••••••
inna rabbee `ala siraatihim mustaqeem, Verily, it is my Lord that is on a straight Path. (11:56)
There is one Sirat al-Mustaqeem, Straight Path, going in a never-ending direction, from pre-Eternal up to
Eternal, always on the right direction. But the wrong desires of people are countless. What you are thinking,
he is not thinking. You can't know what he is thinking, or what the shaykh is thinking, or what the American,
Shaykh Abdur Ra’uf is thinking: "If only I was in Damascus in the arms of my darlingggg." And everyone has
a darling!
"O my darling, where are you?"
"I am here."
"O my darling, I can't see you! Come a little bit closer, so I may look at your beautiful face." He is 100-yearsold and saying, “Beautiful!” (Mawlana Shaykh laughs.)
Everyone wants to find a darling for himself or herself, but they are asking on wrong diversions. You are
teaching me (Shaykh Hisham); I forgot my Shakespeare and now my English is like an Irish market seller's
English. SubhaanAllah. He is granting to His servants, li kulli Majnoonin Layla, “For every crazy one
(Majnoon) there is a loved one (Layla)!” Hisham Effendi, Allah Allah. (Mawlana Shaykh laughs.)
Yes sir, I was meeting with His Holiness, the Pope. May the Lord of Heavens grant to him what His Holiness
is asking! Here he is asking nothing, because he reached the top line, but I was looking to his face, and saw
his eyes were searching for something else! I was looking at His Holiness, the Pope, (who is) not looking at
this world and which thing he is dressing in, no! His Holiness’ eyes were looking for something that common
people can’t understand, only one who is on that level may understand! Just I understood, and at that time I

embraced him and took away everything that was making His Holiness disturbed; it was just taken away.
Therefore, he was coming quickly and my heavenly power was also reaching, taking him. I was hugging His
Holiness and he was light as a feather, coming heavy and going light! His Holiness was visiting Cyprus and he
visited so many countries, but was asking to meet someone who may be a support for him. Throughout the
east and west there was no one, but that one minute of time was enough!
Therefore, everyone is asking for something, but they are not knowing for what they are asking! Only some
people whose hearts belong to heavens know what they are asking! His Holiness was asking to be free. From
whom? Free from himself, and to rise towards the Heavens! Do you understand?
May Allah forgive us. Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah. People asked, "What were you talking about with
His Holiness?" I am saying to those people that I said to him, "Do you like to marry?"
And he was smiling and asked, "Are you happy with marriage?"
I said, "Never finished!"
He replied, "I am also saying to them, but people are never understanding about [the need for] marriage!"
But the real conversation was just one-hundred percent different, but we are speaking as, kalimun-naasa
qadri `uqoolihim, “Talk to people according to their level of understanding.” Whatever is their thinking, what
they are interested in, we are saying on their level, but higher up we can't say! And His Holiness may say
something, but it is really about something else, because such people are asking to follow only one way, not
like this or like that. They are asking to be on the right direction, not on the wrong direction. And people
always like to run on wrong ways for enjoying their dirty egos and dirty desires.
O People! May Allah forgive us. Therefore, His Holiness was coming because he was asking for something for
his original being, but yet our Salafi `ulama are not feeling such things! Therefore, they are asking, but not
coming here! They are saying, "Who is that one?" Yes, I am nothing, but if you come near me you can
understand what we have been granted! That is a speciality for some ones from human nature, and they have
powers. Now His Holiness is taking powers and flying away! And I am saying, yes, towards your Lord's
Divinely Presence, as he was saying when he was flying up.
It is important to find and to follow the right direction, that everything is asking to reach that unchangable

target. And the Lord of Heavens is asking from His servants only, "Ask for true ones! Be true ones and come
to Me without your dirty desires! Throw away your dirty desires and come to Me with your pure, clean
desires, or you can't reach anything here or Hereafter."
May Allah forgive us. O Hisham Effendi, it is a Deepless Ocean! It is not something that they are making a
weak servant to speak, but it is a heavenly grant to make people wake up; that is it and that is true. And we
are asking to be on that Right Way. And now all Mankind lost what they are asking. Therefore, they are
killing each other, making problems and giving much more troubles for each other, and they are asking to
give much more sufferings to each other! Their main aim is only to make people to fall into deepless miseries,
and that is the wrong way!
Therefore, the whole world now is swimming in trouble and there remains no taste from life. And mostly
people are asking to pass away from this dirty life to a clean life, and a clean life is only to make your
direction to Heavens and heavenly beings so that you will be happy forever, up to Eternity, Eternally! May
Allah forgive us.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah.
(Mawlana Shaykh sings.)
Dome dome, dome dome, dome dome, dome dome 4x
Forgive us, O our Lord, for the honor of Your most beloved, glorified, praised, and mighty one in the whole
Creation, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! Allahu akbar. (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits.)
Fatihah.
(Mawlana Shaykh prays two rakaats Salat ash-Shukr.)
Fatihah.
Shaykh Hisham Effendi telephoned? (Shaykh Hisham pretends to phone Mawlana Shaykh and they have a
playful ‘phone conversation.’)
